task.title: Inputs – Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction required

step.cmd: In FTS, from the Caregiver/Compassionate care data entry (MCB1) screen, update the claimant record as follows:

ul.li: Entitlement weeks: Enter the number of weeks the client is entitled to.
Waiting period served: Select Yes or No .
Application date: Enter the date the client requested family caregiver benefits.

step.cmd: Determine if the client is exempt from reporting:
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and cancel the exemption by completing the following fields:

ul.li:
Claimant’s Report:
Rescind: Check the box.

step.cmd: On the Summary tab, determine if an MA01 is imposed:

ul.li:
If no, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and impose the MA01 as follows:
Registration Number: Leave the field blank. If a number is showing, remove it.
Manual action: Select 1 - General suspension of benefits (stop payment) .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .

Work type: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim has already been converted to MPS (CS 8): Select 30 - New information on manual pay claim .
When the claim is not yet in MPS, select 51 - Family caregiver for children or 52 - Family caregiver for adults .
Remarks line 1: Type “Conversion to claim type [20 or 21] as of w/c [XXXX]. Window from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX]. [number of weeks] weeks to be paid. Rescind the MA01.”
Remarks line 2: If a disentitlement is required, type “D[XX] [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X] OP CODE [XX] [X] [XX].” (e.g. D14 w/c 1800-2010 OP CODE 24C09)

Remarks line 3: If an extension of the BP is required, type “Extend [type] [w/c start date] — [number of weeks]. If necessary, provide the NO-CR-CODE and the information from the WP [deferred or waived] and other [WP w/c served].”
Remarks line 4: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a client Note to send a saved ACS letter:
In ACS, review and send the saved letter.
In NWS, determine if the conversion application was submitted using AW:

ul.li: If yes, go to Subsequent claims . Subsequent claims
